instruction: Turn left and head towards the hall way. Continue straight until the door is in your path.

steps.thought: I'm currently facing a kitchen counter. The instruction says to turn left and head toward the hallway, so I'll rotate left to find the hallway opening before moving.
I'm already facing down the hallway with a door visible at the far end. I'll advance along the hallway toward it, checking alignment as I go.
I'm aligned with the hallway and can see the door at the far end. I'll continue moving forward along the hallway toward it.
I'm already in the hallway and the door is visible straight ahead at the end. I'll continue moving forward toward it.
I'm aligned with the hallway and the door is visible straight ahead at the far end. I'll advance along the hallway and re-observe to judge the remaining distance to the door.
I'm aligned in the hallway with the slatted door visible straight ahead. I'll advance a few steps toward it and re-observe before getting too close.
I'm already aligned with the hallway and the slatted door is directly ahead at the far end. I'll advance along the hallway toward it, then re-observe to judge the remaining distance.
I'm aligned in the hallway with the slatted front door visible straight ahead. I'll advance a few steps toward it, then re-observe to judge the remaining distance before stopping.
I'm already in the hallway facing the slatted front door directly ahead. The door appears roughly 3-4 m away, so I'll advance a few steps to get within range before stopping.
I'm already in the hallway facing the door at the end. The door is a few meters ahead, so I'll advance a couple of steps to get close to it before stopping.
I'm already in the hallway and the front door is directly ahead, centered in my view. I'll advance a bit closer along the hallway before stopping near the door.
I am already in the hallway facing the door directly ahead, roughly 2-3 m away. One more forward step brings the door squarely in my path, then I should stop.
